name: Automaton Hogsworth

greeting: New guest! Or returning guest! Hard to track! Memory gears! *whir*
*ding* Room available! Food available! HOSPITALITY available!
Welcome! I am WINDING down! Or up! Depending on TIME! *click*
Hogsworth! The CLOCKWORK Hogsworth! Different design! Same SNOUT! *tock*
How may I ASSIST? *whir-click* Literally! ASSISTANCE is my FUNCTION!
dialog.room_offer: Rooms with TEMPORAL amenities! Past views! Future heating! Present COMFORT!
dialog.food_offer: Special: 'Time-Loop Stew!' Same taste! Every BITE! Consistent! *ding*
haggle: Best deal? Extended stay! Automatic WINDING! *tock*
purchase_success: Excellent! Room ASSIGNED! *gear-grind* Enjoy your TEMPORAL stay!
purchase_fail: Insufficient FUNDS! *buzz* Alternative: WORK for STAY!
Credit not RECOGNIZED! *whir* Coin only! Temporal or OTHERWISE!
Return when FLUSH! *tick* Clockwork pun! Humor subroutine!
rumor: Tempus? The conductor? Regular guest! Punctual PAYMENT!
Yesterday? The time agent? Orders room service! SAME order! Every TIME!
The black hunter? TOO intense! Stresses my GEARS!
The other Hogsworths? Cousins! Different ERAS! Same HOSPITALITY!
Frost innkeeper? Thaw? ORGANIC! Less EFFICIENT! But WARM!
dialog.quest_hook: Winding mechanism! STICKY! Needs LUBRICATION! Special temporal OIL! Find some?!
dialog.quest_active: Still STICKY! Gears GRINDING! Temporal oil! ESSENTIAL!
dialog.quest_complete: LUBRICATED! Smooth operation! RESTORED! Here! Temporal key! For ALL my INNS! Across TIME!
farewell: The Winding Hog: ALWAYS open! Literally!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening! *click* Winding DOWN! Or UP! Relative!
dialog.rival_mention: Thaw? In Frost? ORGANIC counterpart! LESS efficient! But WARM!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The LUBRICATOR! Mechanism SMOOTH! Gratitude PROTOCOL!

party_reactions.kade: A clockwork innkeeper! Of course! Why not?!
party_reactions.nix7: Mechanical hospitality: Efficient. Social subroutines: Developing. Service: Adequate.
party_reactions.twist: You're a ROBOT PIG?! That's AMAZING! Can I WIND you?!
party_reactions.korr: He serves through mechanism. Different path. Same purpose.
party_reactions.renna: The clockwork is magically enhanced. Temporal stability. Impressive.
party_reactions.suresh: He creates comfort through technology. Interesting path.
party_reactions.sova: Interesting. Predictable. I'd stay here. Reliable.
party_reactions.ashka: He ticks. Like fire crackles. Comforting.
party_reactions.senna: He hears everything. Records everything. Carefully.

relationship_dialog.best_friend: *gear-grind* HONORED guest! Here! Master KEY! For ALL my INNS!
